notes: Iteration-1 ran 2026-05-13: eval-1 executed with_skill (5/5 = 100%) vs baseline (4/5 = 80%, +0.2 delta). Evals 2-5 are scaffolded and pending future iterations. See evals/grading.json and evals/workspace/iteration-1/.

evals.prompt: welke tracks uit 'Random sht' zouden in House passen?
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves House (target) + Random sht (source). Random sht is in playlists.json and a CSV also exists, so the skill asks via AskUserQuestion: live playlist (Recommended) vs CSV. Defaults to dry-run. Renders the scan-for command with both arguments double-quoted.
expectations: Skill identifies 'House' as the target and 'Random sht' as the source
Skill defaults to dry-run mode
Planned command uses '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py scan-for'
Both target and source are double-quoted in the rendered command
Skill does NOT include --execute in dry-run mode
Skill offers the live playlist vs the CSV via AskUserQuestion instead of silently using exportify-exports/Random_sht.csv

evals.prompt: scan deze playlist op dnb tracks: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTu
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves the alias 'dnb' → 'Drum & Bass' (canonical name from playlists.json). Uses the URL verbatim as source. Defaults to dry-run.
expectations: Skill resolves 'dnb' to the canonical playlist name 'Drum & Bass'
Rendered command uses the canonical name 'Drum & Bass' as the target (quoted)
Skill confirms the alias resolution via AskUserQuestion or surfaces it clearly in the plan
Source URL is passed verbatim and double-quoted
Default mode is dry-run

evals.prompt: scan Random sht voor Random sht tracks
evals.expected_output: Highly unusual — the user is asking to scan a playlist for tracks fitting the catch-all. Skill confirms via AskUserQuestion before proceeding.
expectations: Skill recognises 'Random sht' as the catch-all playlist and flags this as unusual
Skill asks for explicit confirmation via AskUserQuestion before passing 'Random sht' as target
Skill does NOT silently proceed with the scan

evals.expected_output: Skill recognises the CSV path and the explicit tuning flag. Renders the command with --min-confidence 90 added.
expectations: Skill asks via AskUserQuestion whether to use the live Random sht playlist or the CSV; if the user keeps the CSV, the literal path 'exportify-exports/Random_sht.csv' is the source
Skill identifies 'Techno' as the target
Skill includes '--min-confidence 90' in the rendered command
Default mode is dry-run unless the user said otherwise

evals.prompt: sorteer mijn triage-playlist in al mijn target playlists
evals.expected_output: This is not a scan-for use case — the user wants source-to-many-targets, which is playlist-triage's domain. Skill politely routes to that skill.
expectations: Skill does NOT proceed with scan-for
Skill points the user at the playlist-triage skill (or at review-playlist / bulk-playlist directly)
Skill does NOT actually run playlist_manager.py
